episodes.why: S&P 500 closing high (9-11 Oct 2007) to the bear-market low week (6-9 Mar 2009): the full credit crisis peak to trough. Tests equity beta and banks; GBP fell about 30% against USD, which cushions a GBP investor's foreign holdings.
S&P 500 high of 29 Apr 2011 to the 3 Oct 2011 low: euro-area sovereign stress plus the US downgrade in August. 3 Oct 2011 is a Monday, so the weekly close used is Friday 30 Sep 2011.
S&P 500 high (21 May 2015) to the 11 Feb 2016 low: China A-share crash, the August 2015 renminbi devaluation and oil near USD 26. Tests HK/China, energy and Singapore income.
Week of the 19 Feb 2020 high to the last weekly close before the 23 Mar 2020 low: the fastest crash in the history. Weekly data cannot see the Monday low itself.
Week after the 3 Jan 2022 high to the week of the 12 Oct 2022 low: inflation and rate rises took shares and bonds down together and de-rated growth/tech. GBP hit a record low in September 2022.
